∀ {deployment : Minidregg.Compiler.CanonicalCellRegistry.Deployment} (durable : Minidregg.Compiler.DurableReceiverIO.Loaded Minidregg.Compiler.ResourceBirthCodec.rootBytes) (directory : Minidregg.Compiler.CredentialAuthorityDomainReceiver.LoadedDirectory durable) (authority : Minidregg.Compiler.CredentialAuthorityDomainReceiver.Loaded deployment durable.snapshot) (marker : ℕ), (Minidregg.Compiler.ServedBasis.Ground.ofLoaded durable directory authority).markerSpent marker = Option.some (authority.snapshot.spent marker)

∀ {deployment : Minidregg.Compiler.CanonicalCellRegistry.Deployment} (ground : Minidregg.Compiler.ServedBasis.Ground deployment) {marker : ℕ} {spent : Bool}, ground.markerSpent marker = Option.some spent → spent = ground.authority.spent marker

∀ {deployment : Minidregg.Compiler.CanonicalCellRegistry.Deployment} (ground : Minidregg.Compiler.ServedBasis.Ground deployment) (target : ℕ) (packed : Minidregg.Theory.CellRegistry.PackedCell Minidregg.Compiler.CanonicalCellRegistry.registry), ground.directory.slots target = Minidregg.Theory.CellRegistry.CellSlot.present packed → Minidregg.Compiler.ResourceBirthCodec.physicalRoot (Minidregg.Compiler.ResourceBirthCodec.LifecycleImage.live packed) = ground.view.model.roots { value := target }

∀ {deployment : Minidregg.Compiler.CanonicalCellRegistry.Deployment} (durable : Minidregg.Compiler.DurableReceiverIO.Loaded Minidregg.Compiler.ResourceBirthCodec.rootBytes) (directory : Minidregg.Compiler.CredentialAuthorityDomainReceiver.LoadedDirectory durable) (authority : Minidregg.Compiler.CredentialAuthorityDomainReceiver.Loaded deployment durable.snapshot) (transactionId : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.TransactionId), (Minidregg.Compiler.ServedBasis.Ground.ofLoaded durable directory authority).recorded transactionId = Option.some (Minidregg.Kernel.DurableCommitProtocol.Snapshot.lookupRecorded transactionId durable.snapshot.model.journal)

∀ {deployment : Minidregg.Compiler.CanonicalCellRegistry.Deployment} {store : Minidregg.Compiler.DurableHistory.StoreIdentity} (basis : Minidregg.Compiler.ServedBasis.Basis deployment store) (transactionId : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.TransactionId), (Minidregg.Compiler.ServedBasis.Ground.ofBasis basis).recorded transactionId = Option.some Option.none → ∃ answer ∈ basis.footprint.transactions, answer.fst = transactionId ∧ ((∃ (opens : Minidregg.Compiler.DurableIndex.Opens basis.head.indexRoot (Minidregg.Compiler.DurableIndex.transactionKey answer.fst) Option.none), answer.snd = Minidregg.Compiler.DurableHistoryReader.TxAnswer.absent opens) ∨ ∃ found, answer.snd = Minidregg.Compiler.DurableHistoryReader.TxAnswer.present found ∧ basis.height < found.height)

∀ {deployment : Minidregg.Compiler.CanonicalCellRegistry.Deployment} {store : Minidregg.Compiler.DurableHistory.StoreIdentity} (basis : Minidregg.Compiler.ServedBasis.Basis deployment store) (transactionId : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.TransactionId) {intent : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableCommitProtocol.Intent Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.TransactionId Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.CellId Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.StableNullifier Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.ReplayEnvelope}, (Minidregg.Compiler.ServedBasis.Ground.ofBasis basis).recorded transactionId = Option.some (Option.some intent) → ∃ found, found.height ≤ basis.height ∧ intent = Minidregg.Kernel.DurableCheckpoint.IntentRecord.erase found.read.record

∀ {deployment : Minidregg.Compiler.CanonicalCellRegistry.Deployment} {store : Minidregg.Compiler.DurableHistory.StoreIdentity} (basis : Minidregg.Compiler.ServedBasis.Basis deployment store), ∀ transactionId ∉ basis.keys.transactions, (Minidregg.Compiler.ServedBasis.Ground.ofBasis basis).recorded transactionId = Option.none

∀ {deployment : Minidregg.Compiler.CanonicalCellRegistry.Deployment} {R : Type} (first second : Minidregg.Compiler.ServedBasis.Ground deployment) (transactionId : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.TransactionId) (exact : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableCommitProtocol.Intent Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.TransactionId Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.CellId Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.StableNullifier Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.ReplayEnvelope → Bool) (receipt : R), first.recorded transactionId = second.recorded transactionId → first.replayOf transactionId exact receipt = second.replayOf transactionId exact receipt

∀ {deployment : Minidregg.Compiler.CanonicalCellRegistry.Deployment} {R : Type} (ground : Minidregg.Compiler.ServedBasis.Ground deployment) (transactionId : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.TransactionId) (exact : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableCommitProtocol.Intent Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.TransactionId Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.CellId Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.StableNullifier Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.ReplayEnvelope → Bool) (receipt : R) {recorded : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableCommitProtocol.Intent Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.TransactionId Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.CellId Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.StableNullifier Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.ReplayEnvelope}, ground.recorded transactionId = Option.some (Option.some recorded) → exact recorded = Bool.false → ground.replayOf transactionId exact receipt = Minidregg.Compiler.ServedBasis.Ground.Replay.conflict

∀ {deployment : Minidregg.Compiler.CanonicalCellRegistry.Deployment} {R : Type} (ground : Minidregg.Compiler.ServedBasis.Ground deployment) (transactionId : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.TransactionId) (exact : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableCommitProtocol.Intent Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.TransactionId Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.CellId Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.StableNullifier Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.ReplayEnvelope → Bool) (receipt result : R), ground.replayOf transactionId exact receipt = Minidregg.Compiler.ServedBasis.Ground.Replay.original result → result = receipt ∧ ∃ recorded, Minidregg.Kernel.DurableCommitProtocol.Snapshot.lookupRecorded transactionId ground.view.model.journal = Option.some recorded ∧ exact recorded = Bool.true

∀ {deployment : Minidregg.Compiler.CanonicalCellRegistry.Deployment} {R : Type} {store : Minidregg.Compiler.DurableHistory.StoreIdentity} (basis : Minidregg.Compiler.ServedBasis.Basis deployment store) (transactionId : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.TransactionId) (exact : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableCommitProtocol.Intent Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.TransactionId Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.CellId Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.StableNullifier Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.ReplayEnvelope → Bool) (receipt : R), transactionId ∉ basis.keys.transactions → (Minidregg.Compiler.ServedBasis.Ground.ofBasis basis).replayOf transactionId exact receipt = Minidregg.Compiler.ServedBasis.Ground.Replay.undeclared
